data.name: FROST x HIME
data.detailed_description:
⌬This game is specially prepared for those who are unable to purchase Snow x Hime⌬

 

The story follows a sword maiden brimming with chivalry — sensual and mature, her slender blade and graceful figure merge as one, blending passion and romance into a single form. Her delicate silhouette rushes across the battlefield, fighting countless foes, as blood blooms like crimson roses. She herself is a rose of the battlefield — breathtakingly beautiful, yet her sharp thorns wound any who dare to approach, scattering like falling cherry blossoms.
The game also features numerous exquisite outfits that perfectly accentuate her alluring figure — from black-stockinged qipaos that highlight her mature charm, to elegant and graceful designs that exude gentle femininity.

  

 

 

About Us:
We are a two-person independent development team. When our funds were nearly depleted, we planned to release the game in Early Access — but it failed to pass official review. In desperation, we made the bold decision to launch it directly.
Releasing the game to players while so much remained unfinished was a reckless mistake on our part. At launch, the reviews were terrible, and for a time we were utterly disheartened and devastated.

Thanks to the warm encouragement and support of many players, we managed to endure our darkest days, giving the game a chance to slowly improve and rise again.
Although there is still much left to fix, we are continuously working to make it better — including upgrading the H-content to higher quality.

This little adult game that once fell to the bottom but is now rising again — we truly hope you’ll come to love it.

 

 

 

A Pure Boss-Fight Action Game

No mobs. No dungeons. Only a series of unique boss battles.

Defeat them through blocking, dodging, counterattacks, perfect parries, stagger breaks, combos, and executions. Unlock new outfits along the way and uncover the truth behind the story.

 

 

Core Gameplay

Pure Boss Battles: Jump straight into the fight, focusing entirely on reading attacks and reacting with timing.

Every Boss Is Unique: Distinct weapons, movesets, and combat rhythms—adapt and find your strategy.

High-Intensity Combat System:

Block / Dodge: The foundation of survival.

Counterattack / Perfect Parry: Turn the tide with precision timing.

Stagger → Combo → Execution: Break their guard, unleash offense, and finish the fight.

Characters & Unlocks

Alluring Female Bosses: Each with her own unique appearance and personality.

Multiple Outfits: Defeat bosses to earn new costumes and customize looks.

Memory Shards: Every victory grants a shard, gradually revealing the full story and the truth behind the trial.

What You’ll Experience

Clear, rewarding progression: learn moves → stagger break → execution → unlock outfits and memories.

A stable challenge curve, with every battle refreshed by new weapons, moves, and rhythms.

If you enjoy action games that reward reading enemy patterns, mastering timing, and relying on pure skill to win—this is the one made for you.

data.short_description: Pure boss battle action. No mobs or dungeons, only unique duels where reading attacks and timing decide victory. Use block, dodge, counter and perfect parry, then Stagger→Combo→Execution to break guards. Wins unlock outfits and Memory Fragments that reveal the story.
